title: Discourse Map
description: Structured output of the global discourse pass for a chapter. Anchored at chapter level. Establishes the discourse framework — QUDs, argument structure, boundaries, relational dynamics — that grounds the verse-level analyses.

model.description: Model that produced this observation. Set by the pipeline after generation, not by the LLM itself.

resources.description: Resources used to produce this observation, e.g. ["interpresure", "macula", "bart_displays"]. Empty list for zero-shot runs.

dominant_quds.description: The dominant Questions Under Discussion active across this chapter.

argument_structure.description: Prose description of the argumentative, narrative, or poetic arc of the chapter.

verse_start.description: First verse of this discourse unit.

verse_end.description: Last verse of this discourse unit.

description.description: What this discourse unit is doing — its function in the chapter's argument or narrative.

discourse_boundaries.description: Discourse units with verse ranges and functional descriptions.

relational_dynamics.description: The social and relational context operative across the chapter.

active_scales.description: Scalar dimensions active in this chapter.

key_presuppositions.description: Background assumptions the chapter takes for granted.

genre_notes.description: Genre and register observations affecting interpretation.
